findings.text: The caption states both arms came from one allocation at revision 6a404a566, but h200-prefix.log names revision 7b2a7898 and slurm job 1303768 while h200-base2.log is job 1303773, and the other base-labelled arm h200-base.log reports 38.18 ms tangent against base2's 27.83 ms without reconciliation, so the headline cost rests on an unreconciled, cross-allocation pair.
The receipts paragraph cites compare.log for the byte-identical CPU tangent, but no compare.log exists in the run directory, so the numerical-identity claim has no readable receipt.

The census paragraph asserts three interior copies and the table repeats 3 against 2, but h200-prefix.log prints two tagged interior sites (interior:whole, interior:cut) and both base-labelled arm logs print no TAG-TAGGED lines, so the base arm's three-copy census is asserted rather than receipted.

read() matches STAGE_DEVICE name={name} but is called with name 'base' and 'head' at lines 26-27, which no stage row carries, so both dicts are empty and the script raises KeyError at line 32 instead of regenerating the committed figure.
The committed script runs tests/test_bank_step_booking_once.py, which is absent from the landed tree, so the landed negative control cannot be re-run by a later reader.
The loop over re.findall results ends immediately in pass so it computes nothing, and the surrounding lower/count logic duplicates hlo_tags.py in the same directory.

outside_scope records that no fresh-read residual and no oracle ratio were measured, so the first half of the done_when's measure was not produced; the recorded gate tests/test_bank_step_booking.py asserts none of those quantities.
